Quantum 1.13.0 was certified on 2026-08-19. It pins **nucleus v1.9.1**, **quark v1.5.0** and **orbit v1.6.2**, with 5 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.12.0: nucleus goes from v1.8.0 to v1.9.1 (minor), orbit goes from v1.6.1 to v1.6.2 (patch) and quark stays at v1.5.0. 3 sibling modules change version.
